Enjoy the timeless melody of “Huzoor Is Kadar Bhi Na Itrake Chaliye” from the classic Hindi film Masoom (1983). Featuring the memorable performances of Shabana Azmi and Naseeruddin Shah, this beautiful song brings together soulful vocals by Bhupinder Singh and Suresh Wadkar with the unforgettable musical touch of R. D. Burman.
